Attached: 1 video

Most Mac desktops look like a digital junk drawer. It is easy to lose track of files when screenshots and downloads pile up. You can use the native Mac Desktop Stacks feature to group everything by file type or date with just two clicks. I put together a quick guide and video on how to set it up here: https://gwizit.com/go/ULsVWZU
